name: Baklava
description: Dozens of butter-brushed filo layers packed with pistachios or walnuts and soaked in a fragrant sugar syrup.
ingredients: a handful of fresh parsley, chopped
instructions: Preheat your oven (or set up your steamer or frying station) and lightly grease your pan or molds with olive oil.
In a large bowl, whisk together the rice pilaf and Aleppo pepper until evenly combined.
In a separate bowl, blend the lemon wedges with the chicken stock until smooth and well incorporated.
Gently fold the wet mixture into the dry ingredients, taking care not to overmix.
Transfer everything to your prepared pan or molds and cook — bake, steam, chill, or fry — until set, about 45 mins.
Remove from the heat and let it cool completely; this helps the texture firm up perfectly.
tips: Resist opening the oven door too early — a sudden change in temperature can cause the dessert to sink or crack.
This keeps well for a couple of days in an airtight container, and the flavor often improves overnight.
